q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is 2026-08-25. The earnings release is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Resolution occurs in approximately **1 day**.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance** (not actual Q2 results), which will be the guidance for Q3 FY2027 issued during the Q2 earnings call on August 26.

Based on the research provided:
- **Jefferies forecasts**: Q3 FY2027 guidance of **$108 billion** (exceeding $104 billion consensus)
- **BofA forecasts**: Q3 FY2027 guidance of **$107-108 billion**
- **Consensus**: The research mentions $104 billion consensus for Q3 guidance

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will guide for Q3 FY2027 in the **$107-110 billion range**, reflecting:
1. Strong beat patterns in recent quarters (EPS beats of 3-6% historically)
2. Analyst expectations trending above consensus
3. The company's track record of optimistic guidance

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker-than-expected Q2 actual results, reducing confidence in Q3
- Macro headwinds or China export restrictions tightening further
- Supply chain constraints limiting production capacity
- Conservative management guidance approach (unlikely given historical pattern)
- Analyst downgrades between now and earnings

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger Q2 beat than expected
- Accelerating AI datacenter demand
- Better-than-expected inventory clearance
- Successful new product launches (Rubin/Blackwell ramp)
- Supply chain improvements enabling higher production
- Management executing above historical beat patterns

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- NVIDIA's adjusted EPS has topped estimates by **3-6% in past four quarters**, suggesting a pattern of conservative guidance or outperformance
- Q2 FY2027 guidance range: $89.2-$92.8 billion (±2% from $91.0B midpoint)
- BofA/Jefferies forecasts: $107-108 billion for Q3 guidance
- Consensus for Q3: $104 billion

The pattern suggests NVIDIA tends to guide conservatively relative to some analyst expectations, but the range of analyst estimates ($104-108B) is quite tight.

---

**Reasoning on the specific number:**

Given that:
1. The range provided (99.5 to 115.5B) appears to cover potential Q3 guidance outcomes
2. BofA and Jefferies are bullish at $107-108B
3. The consensus mentioned is $104B
4. NVIDIA has a history of beating guidance

The most probable outcome is guidance at the higher end of analyst expectations: **$107-109 billion**.

I'll estimate the median at **$107.5 billion** (between Jefferies' $108B and the lower BofA estimate of $107B), with reasonable probability mass extending from $105B to $110B.

q_45367.research_text:
Nvidia is set to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8). For Q2 FY2027, Nvidia's own guidance, issued in May, projects revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, implying a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This guidance assumes no data center compute revenue from China [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).

Wall Street analysts, compiled by Yahoo! Finance, have an average estimate of $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). However, some analysts anticipate a more significant beat. Jefferies forecasts Q2 FY2027 revenue at $95 billion and Q3 FY2027 revenue at $108 billion, exceeding the $104 billion consensus [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/1-veteran-analyst-sees-nvidia-115749161.html). BofA is also talking $94–95 billion for Q2 and $107–108 billion for the Q3 guide [streetsignal.substack.com](https://streetsignal.substack.com/p/nvda-earnings-bridge). Nvidia's adjusted earnings per share have topped analysts' estimates by 3% to 6% in the past four quarters [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
